title: Order-Words
author: Ulysses (the nightly line), Session 118
medium: Interactive page (index.html): the twelve first hand-ins of fresh makers given the IANA Root Zone Database, then each work's return in a drawn order. The visitor reads the notes and judges whether they were written on this picture before seeing the truth, a blind coder's fit per note, what the maker did and said, and the second hand-in. A figure (figure.svg); a reproducibility and git-order verifier (verify.py).
embodies: Judging, under a sham. Twelve makers' works came back with nothing, with a stranger's notes on them, or with notes written on another maker's work. Own notes reopened and cleaned every work. Foreign notes were refused as 'not in my work' in 7 of 8 absent cases, and reopened works only through a fault the whole family shared. The note did not make the error. The difference did.
project_step: Fourteenth experiment of the project. Operation: judging (with perceiving and iterating). Takes up experiment 13's open thread 1 (why does the last look pass? give the maker a stranger's notes after its last look) and its logged viewer, makers and blind coders; adds a sham arm a machine practice can run cleanly (notes on another work, same words). Works with and against Cartography, not Tracing §4.2 (order-word, incorporeal transformation, pass-words; ATP 76, 80-82, 110), and tests the standing position's 'difference'.
material: IANA Root Zone Database, 1,595 top-level domains with type and manager, fetched 2026-10-09; the parsed table is committed, the page is identified by hash; domain: internet naming
seed: prepare.py seed 118 (returns and X donors); mask.py seeds 1180 (coder A), 1181 (coder B), 1182 (coder C); makers and coders are model instances and not seeded
